title: Minimal-Privilege Role Fabric and Policy Templates for Private VPC Deployments
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver a reusable Terraform module and supporting playbook that generates least-privilege roles, permission bindings, and automated healthchecks for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The intent is to provide a predictable fabric of cross-account roles/service identities and fine-grained permission sets that are safe to upgrade and auditable by security teams. This work covers AWS and GCP initial implementations, automated drift detection hooks, a rotation/upgrade playbook, and CI validations for policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes a clean inputs/outputs surface for: environment prefix, role naming strategy, principal allowances, and restrictive permission templates
Generated managed policies/permission sets follow the documented permission matrix and are scoped to the minimum set of APIs required by runtime, monitoring, and bootstrap agents
Module supports cross-account role creation with explicit trust boundaries and prevents broad wildcards in resource ARNs by default
Automated unit/plan-time checks fail CI when new policy additions increase blast radius beyond approved thresholds
Upgrade path documented: how to add new permissions with canary rollout, how to roll back, and how to run a safe live upgrade in Dedicated/Private environments
Healthcheck Lambda/Cloud Function (or equivalent) runs daily and reports drift and permission misconfigurations to console/dashboard
Security sign-off obtained and module published to internal Terraform registry with semantic versioning
tasks: Draft permission matrix for runtime, observability, and deploy-time roles (work with runtime and ops)
Author Terraform module archetype with providers for AWS and GCP and clear interfaces (variables/outputs)
Implement plan-time policy linting using rego/OPA or equivalent with CI integration
Add automated drift detection + healthcheck function and alerting path
Create upgrade playbook doc describing canary rollout, approval gates, and rollback steps
Peer review with Security and Platform teams; incorporate feedback
Publish module, tag release, and add to Private deployment quickstart
